<h2>Resolve the Projection for Spatial Predictors</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Chooses the coordinate reference system used to project a model unit's
coordinates, from the unit's continent and the per-continent projection
map.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_spatial_crs(
  scale_id = NULL,
  continent_id = NULL,
  crs_by_continent,
  file_spatial_grid = here::here("Data/Input/spatial_grid.csv")
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="scale_id">scale_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional spatial-unit identifier from the spatial grid catalogue, as
returned by [resolve_scale_id_from_store()]. 'NULL' for stores that are not
spatial units, such as temporal stores.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="continent_id">continent_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional continent identifier from the profile ('continent_id'), used when
there is no 'scale_id'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="crs_by_continent">crs_by_continent</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named list mapping continent identifiers to an EPSG integer or a CRS
string accepted by [project_coords_to_metric()]
('spatial_crs_by_continent' in the configuration).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="file_spatial_grid">file_spatial_grid</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the spatial grid catalogue.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>A 'scale_id' is mapped to its continent with
[resolve_continent_ids_from_scale_ids()]. When both a 'scale_id' and a
'continent_id' are given they must agree. The function aborts when no
continent can be determined or the continent has no projection, so a
missing entry never falls back to the European projection (issue #204).
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The projection for the unit's continent: an integer EPSG code or one CRS
string.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[project_coords_to_metric()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_spatial_crs(
  continent_id = "europe",
  crs_by_continent = list(europe = 3035L)
)
</code></pre>
